requirements.req_text: Crime in Your Community, State, and Nation. Do the following: (a) With your parent or guardian's permission and the approval of your counselor, research local, state, or national news coverage of three crimes of different types. (b) Record notes on which law enforcement agencies and courts were involved in the pursuit of justice for the victims and the accused person, why you think these crimes were committed, and what could be done to prevent similar crimes. Review your research with your counselor.
